decisions.reason: Industrial explosion-proof luminaires remain a strong strategic fit with our industrial and maritime customers and engineering capabilities, and the multi-model range suggests a durable specialist line despite limited recent website evidence.

The designer task light is a narrower and more style-driven standalone product, and its disappearance from later website observations suggests it is less central than our core professional solution business.
The pendant office luminaire fits our offer but is easier to rationalise because it is a single product in a crowded office-lighting segment and may be overlapped by newer, broader ranges.

The premium pendant luminaire is close to our established office and commercial business, and the fact that it was launched as a product line with several models supports keeping it as part of a higher-value portfolio.
